Historical 25 kPa penalty runs before adaptive inner-FEM refinement failed abrupt ±2 mm clicks at a 4.069 µs attempt (about 101/216 µN residual). Their accepted states remained finite, exactly fixed at supports and non-inverted. The original failures are retained; subsequent fixes and the current ALM 30-case matrix are separate evidence.

Current default ALM passes all 30 completion/integrity scenarios, but nominal 1 has substantial automatic force-history differences versus nominal 8, including sustained embedded intervals away from event windows. Nominal 4 improves agreement; nominal 8 is not established as converged.

The adopted finite-ALM PC tolerance 0.01 retains a failed 12.46 µm fast-handling trajectory comparison; analytic normal elimination retains a failed 16.40 µm matched-schedule comparison. The same-source repeat difference of 0.219 µm shows these failures cannot be dismissed as generic GPU noise.
